Comments:
- **Layout (10 points): 7/10** — The main structure is highly similar: header, navigation controls, timer card, task status, and task section are arranged in the same order. However, the generated page uses a taller full-screen layout and omits the visible informational content below the task area that appears in the reference.
- **Elements (15 points): 10/15** — Most major elements are present, including the Pomofocus branding, four header buttons, timer tabs, countdown, Start button, task heading, overflow button, and Add Task area. Some icons differ noticeably, and the reference includes a scrollbar and lower-page content that are absent from the generated view.
- **Content and Text (40 points): 27/40** — Text labels are largely reproduced accurately, including “Pomofocus,” “Pomodoro,” “Short Break,” “Long Break,” “START,” “Tasks,” and “Add Task.” However, the active tab differs: the reference selects “Short Break,” while the generated page selects “Long Break.” The timer also differs, showing “05:00” in the reference versus “15:00” in the generated page. The lower explanatory headings and paragraph text are missing.
- **Style (15 points): 8/15** — Typography, spacing, rounded cards, button treatment, and general visual styling are broadly similar. The dominant color palette is substantially different: the reference uses a muted mauve/pink theme, while the generated page uses teal. Icon styling and some contrast relationships also differ.
- **Overall (20 points): 12/20** — The generated page clearly represents the same Pomofocus timer interface and matches the overall composition, but the incorrect theme, selected timer state, countdown value, iconography, and missing lower content reduce visual and functional similarity.

**Score: 64/100**

Comments:
- **Layout (10 points): 8/10** — The overall structure is highly similar: header, timer card, session information, and task section appear in the same order and with comparable spacing. The generated version is slightly narrower due to the scrollbar, and the timer/task sections are vertically shifted. It also includes an additional white informational section below the task area.
- **Elements (15 points): 11/15** — Major elements are present and correctly positioned, including navigation buttons, timer tabs, countdown, start button, task menu, divider, and add-task area. Several icons differ from the reference, including the logo/checkmark, chart icon, profile icon, and add-task symbol.
- **Content and Text (40 points): 35/40** — Primary text content matches closely: “Pomofocus,” “Pomodoro,” “Short Break,” “Long Break,” “25:00,” “START,” “#1,” “Time to focus!,” “Tasks,” and “Add Task.” The generated page adds explanatory content below the main interface that is not visible in the reference.
- **Style (15 points): 11/15** — Typography, rounded cards, button styling, red/pink color palette, and white text are broadly consistent. However, the exact background colors, icon styling, panel tones, and some font sizing/weight differ noticeably.
- **Overall (20 points): 16/20** — The generated webpage is a strong reproduction of the main Pomofocus interface, with the same overall visual hierarchy and functionality. Differences in icons, colors, vertical spacing, and the additional content section prevent it from being pixel-level identical.

**Score: 81/100**

Comments:
- **Layout (10 points): 3/10** — The reference begins with the task-focused view and an open task editor near the top, followed by an informational content section. The generated page instead includes a full navigation bar, timer panel, task list, and places the editor much lower on the page, resulting in a substantially different vertical structure.
- **Elements (15 points): 6/15** — Several shared elements are present, including the “#1 / Time to focus!” heading, Tasks section, task editor, Pomodoro count controls, note/project links, and menu buttons. However, the generated page adds prominent timer and task-list components that are not present in the reference and omits the reference’s explanatory content section.
- **Content and Text (40 points): 20/40** — The task-editor text is reasonably similar, including “What are you working on?”, “Est Pomodoros,” “+ Add Note,” and “+ Add Project.” The reference’s main informational text—“An online Pomodoro Timer to boost your productivity,” “What is Pomofocus?”, and the descriptive paragraph—is missing. The generated page also contains extra task and timer text.
- **Style (15 points): 9/15** — The red/maroon and white color palette, rounded cards, bold headings, and general Pomofocus visual language are similar. Differences in spacing, component sizing, button treatments, borders, and typography reduce the match.
- **Overall (20 points): 7/20** — Although the generated page appears to be the same general application and shares some text and styling, the visible state and page composition differ significantly from the reference.

**Score: 45/100**
